description: Lists mobile app automation sessions (tests), newest first, 10 per page by default, with their video, screenshot and log links. Page with limit and offset, or filter by buildId or status; the result gives the total the API reports.

buildId.description: Only sessions of this build (build_id from listMobileBuilds)

status.description: Only sessions with this status, e.g. passed, failed, completed, error

name: listMobileSessions
title: List Mobile Sessions
